newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks up on bargain-hunting, speculation.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks up on bargain-hunting, speculation.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were higher in early trading on Tuesday on local speculative buying of small stocks and bargain-hunting in financial counters, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 2.14 points, or 0.33 percent, to 644.40 points after 55 minutes of trading. Advancers led decliners by 47 to 25 with 48 issues unchanged.
"Some of the financial counters including BII and BNI were the target of bargain-hunting as they are considered to have bottomed out," one broker said.
The most actively traded stock, small-sized property firm Elang Realty, rose 25 rupiah to 950 rupiah, with some 12 million shares traded on market talk of a possible rights issue.
Elang Realty officials were not immediately available for comment.
